name: Team Charmander: Blazing Crucible & Seismic Assault
archetype: 4x Fire super-effective heat, 4x Fighting close combat, and Electric special artillery.
gym_duel_rationale: Pryce's 5v5 ice hockey duel prompts the player to select 5 active Pokémon from the party: Charizard/Venusaur commands the front line, firing STAB Flamethrower to instantly incinerate Mamoswine/Bastiodon with 4x super-effective heat while melting Probopass/Cloyster and shredding Water hybrids with Petal Dance; Primeape/Sandslash rotates into the duel core to unleash devastating 4x STAB Close Combat against both Mamoswine/Bastiodon and Probopass/Cloyster, while dousing Infernape/Weavile with Earthquake; Alakazam/Raichu electrocutes Dewgong/Slowking and ace Jynx/Wailord with STAB Thunderbolt while executing Infernape/Weavile with Psychic; Gyarados/Nidoking applies Intimidate to blunt physical assault and batters foes with Aqua Tail; and Snorlax utilizes Thick Fat to cut incoming Ice damage by 50%, completely walling Blizzard attacks with Rest sustain.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor elevated to Cap 67. STAB Flamethrower incinerates Mamoswine/Bastiodon with 4x super-effective heat, and Petal Dance melts Water hybrids.

roster.status: Active in Party (Rotated into Duel Core)
roster.progression_notes: 477 BST physical wallbreaker elevated to Lv. 66. STAB Close Combat lands lethal 4x super-effective blows on Mamoswine/Bastiodon and Probopass/Cloyster.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. STAB Thunderbolt electrocutes Dewgong/Slowking and Jynx/Wailord; STAB Psychic cleanly executes Infernape/Weavile.
522 BST physical pivot. Intimidate neutralizes physical attack on switch-in. Aqua Tail provides heavy neutral physical water power against Infernape/Weavile.

roster.role: Thick Fat Ice Wall & Sustained Tank
roster.progression_notes: Colossal 160 HP tank. Thick Fat halves incoming Ice attacks, completely walling Pryce's Blizzard artillery while out-sustaining with Rest and Leftovers.

roster.status: Active in Party (Benched for Gym Duel)
roster.progression_notes: 535 BST Water/Ice wall. Benched during Pryce's duel to favor offensive super-effective duelists, but serves as route surfing anchor.

flex_bench.rationale: High-Speed Flying pivot providing Tailwind speed doubling and Roost recovery.
Levitate Ground immunity and high physical Defense with Sludge Bomb against physical attackers.
Iron Fist-boosted Thunder Punch and Ice Punch for versatile tech coverage.
